_comment: The owner-identifier gate's per-repo lists: config files to read for account names, and local-data files allowed to hold an identifier, each with a reason.

localDataReasons.guide/index.html: A public GitHub Pages site: its canonical, sitemap and image URLs sit under the owner's Pages domain, so each page names the account by necessity.
